correctness.rationale: Independently classified the relative faces by their common-neighbor witnesses. Old-only faces witnessed at the leaf are empty or old singletons that still have a witness in their color fiber, so the target is induced even if the old neighbor becomes isolated. A pair of distinct leaf colors has a unique witness, the third leaf color, so its edge and triangle form a free pair. After the three such deletions, each remaining new-color face lies in that color's cone x_i*L_i. Pair each such face lacking h_i with its extension by h_i, in reverse inclusion order. All other strict cofaces have then been deleted. This proves the relative collapse and the exact 3+3·2^(d+1) pair count for every finite simple H. Tree pruning terminates at the triangle boundary; cyclic annular strips also independently verify the credited n≥5 torus consequence. See /workspace/evidence/proof_checks.md, section 2; the frozen finite checker was inspected, not executed.
residual_risks: Scope is the ordinary open neighborhood complex with the Cartesian K3 factor, not arbitrary clique factors.
